def ballpos(f):
    L=f.ascii.split('\n')
    for r in range(36,45):
        for c in range(6,16):
            if r<len(L) and c<len(L[r]) and L[r][c]=='N': return (r,c)
    return None
print("start ball",ballpos(current_frame))
seq=['UP','UP','DOWN','RIGHT','UP']
for a in seq:
    action([a])
    r=last_action_result
    print(a,"ball",ballpos(current_frame),"done",r.get('done'),"lvl",r.get('level_completed'),"go",r.get('game_over'))
    if r.get('done') or r.get('level_completed') or r.get('game_over'):
        print("STOP"); break
